# AdashimaVerse

AdashimaVerse is an unofficial fan archive for *Adachi to Shimamura*, covering the light novels, manga adaptations, anime, extra stories, music, gallery, timeline, and related reference material.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://adashimaverse.com/)
- [Light Novels](https://adashimaverse.com/Adashima_Novelas)
- [Manga](https://adashimaverse.com/Adashima_Manga)
- [Anime](https://adashimaverse.com/Adashima_Anime)
- [Extra Stories](https://adashimaverse.com/Adashima_Extra_Stories)
- [Music](https://adashimaverse.com/Adashima_Music)
- [Gallery](https://adashimaverse.com/Adashima_Gallery)
- [Timeline](https://adashimaverse.com/Adashima_Linea)
- [About](https://adashimaverse.com/Adashima_About)

## Content

The site provides fan-maintained bibliographic information, series news, development updates, reading resources, and navigation to official sources. Official rights remain with their respective creators and publishers.
